For complex weights, show convergent exponential logarithm and exact branch equality; no probability-sign inequality for the interacting measure may replace zero-freeness.

Derive divergence from the full pulled-back top form. det C_s, vacuum action, Haar constant and outward orientations must remain until normalized cancellation.

For link balls, distinguish scalar top dimension, radial surface dimension, and block/link product independence. Fixing a link on its sphere changes a block measure rather than individual independent scalars.
